summary.text: Roland Martin, also known as Danny, is the Democratic candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where he faces incumbent Republican Roger Albert.
He previously represented District 150 in the Maine House from December 2014 to December 2022.

paragraphs.text: Roland Martin was first sworn into the Maine House of Representatives, representing District 150, on December 2, 2014, and left office on December 6, 2022 without seeking re-election.
Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the State and Local Government Committee in the 2015, 2017 and 2019-2020 sessions and as chair of the Transportation Committee in 2021-2022.
Martin ran for District 2 in 2024 and lost the general election to Roger Albert, 55.6 percent to 44.4 percent, and he advanced from the June 9, 2026 Democratic primary for a rematch.
